Level 4 - Advanced 45 min System Design Kafka

Big Data: Batch, Streaming & Probabilistic Structures

Learn how companies crunch petabytes: why analytics needs different databases, how MapReduce, Spark and Flink split work across thousands of machines, how stream processors handle late events, and three tiny data structures that answer huge questions in kilobytes.
